ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the $20 billion spent on Medicaid programs at high risk for fraud since 2018
questions: What are the most common types of fraud in the Medicaid program?
How can the state prevent future instances of fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in the Medicaid program, and could lead to significant reforms and accountability
